text.en:
Item (21), under "al. Nueva Vizcaya," section two of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(21) Construction and improvement of:
(a) La Torre Elementary School Home Economics Building, Bayombong ₱10,000.00
(b) Malasin Elementary School Home Economics Building, Dupax 10,000.00"
Section 2 . This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
